title: HDL and Alzheimer’s disease: recent advances and therapeutic implications
title_zh: 高密度脂蛋白与阿尔茨海默病：最新进展与治疗意义
abstract: Abstract High-density lipoproteins (HDL) belong to a group of lipid-protein complexes that are assembled in extracellular space and circulate as soluble nanoparticles in biological fluids, transporting lipids and associated molecules from and to cells throughout the body. Although discovered first, HDL remains to be the least understood among all lipoproteins. While initially studied primarily in the systemic circulation, interest in HDL-like particles in the brain has grown following the discovery of the HDL-associated apolipoprotein APOE4 as the greatest genetic risk factor for late-onset sporadic Alzheimer’s disease (AD), linking HDL with neurodegeneration as well as cardiovascular disease. This review aims to summarize growing lines of evidence that demonstrate the roles of HDL and HDL-like particles in multiple interconnected processes implicated in AD pathophysiology, including amyloid and tau pathology, neuroinflammation, mitochondrial function, cerebrovascular integrity, lipid metabolism, and synaptic function, as well as underscoring the paradigm shift from HDL levels to HDL function. In addition, this review highlights the potential of emerging HDL-targeted interventions for AD and discusses future research directions.
abstract_zh: 摘要 高密度脂蛋白（HDL）是一类在细胞外空间组装并作为可溶性纳米颗粒在生物液体中循环的脂蛋白复合物，负责在全身运输脂质及相关分子。尽管HDL最早被发现，但它仍是所有脂蛋白中认知度最低的。虽然HDL最初主要在体循环中研究，但随着HDL相关的载脂蛋白APOE4被确认为晚发性家族性阿尔茨海默病（AD）的最大遗传学风险因子，人们对大脑中类似HDL的颗粒的兴趣日益增长，这将HDL与神经退行性疾病及心血管疾病联系起来。本综述旨在总结日益增长的证据，阐明HDL和HDL样颗粒在阿尔茨海默病病理过程中多个相互关联的机制中的作用，包括β淀粉样蛋白和tau病理、神经炎症、线粒体功能、脑血管完整性、脂质代谢以及突触功能，并强调从HDL浓度向HDL功能的范式转移。此外，本综述还突出了针对阿尔茨海默病的新兴HDL靶向干预的潜力，并讨论了未来的研究方向。
